page.layout: One page of text: running head at the top; running text in full width; below it the word FINIS spaced out, then an engraved ornament (woodcut, no text); at the foot the heading INDEX in italic capitals.

main_text.l: clamoribus adversariorum, ex quibus satis superque attento & judi-
cioso lectori patebit, nihil quicquam hactenus adversarios omnibus suis
machinis obtinuisse, remque manere in integro, ac, cum ex
dictis pateat, sententiis Cartesii nullum esse cum sacris literis dissidium,
nihil aliud restare, quàm ut eæ, num veræ, num falsæ sint, per
lumen rationis examinentur, quod ex parte etiam in hoc tractatu est factum.

page.notes: The running head reads "422" as the page number with "CHR. WITTICHII CONSENSUS VERITATIS." as the running title. The spaced word FINIS is printed in capitals and set as a heading. The engraved ornament below FINIS has no text. INDEX is set in italic capitals at the foot of the page and is treated as a division title. There are scattered ink spots and foxing on the scan, which are not printed text.
